title: Native generation request (POST /v1/audio/generations)
description: Project-owned native API contract, version 1. Not an OpenAI or OpenRouter schema. Unknown fields are rejected. The prompt ceiling here is the policy ceiling; the gateway must also enforce the qualified tokenizer limit once measured (config/model-profile.json).

prompt.description: Measured in Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units. Never truncated; overlong prompts are rejected.

seed.description: Optional. When omitted the gateway chooses one, persists it before submission, and never changes it on infrastructure retry.

output_format.description: Per request. mp3 = 192 kbit/s CBR (default); wav = PCM16; flac = lossless 16-bit. All 44.1 kHz stereo. Owner decision 2026-09-26.
